subject: *: enable the predicate columns feature by default (#54440)
summary: This commit flips the default `tidb_analyze_column_options` from `ALL` to `PREDICATE` for new clusters, and adds bootstrap upgrade v210 to initialize the global var to `ALL` when upgrading from versions where the sysvar row didn’t exist, preserving legacy behavior for existing clusters; no Blocker/High correctness/semantics/consistency/concurrency issues found in the touched planner/session/sessionctx/statistics/table/executor areas.
